# Northbeam Signals

## What it does
- Signal feed: watches funding, hiring, leadership changes and tool installs across your target accounts
- Account scoring: ranks accounts by ICP fit and how fresh their signals are
- First-line drafts: writes the opening line from the signal, in the buyer's words

## Facts we can state
- Tracks 6 signal types across up to 25,000 accounts
- Refreshes signals every 24 hours
- Connects to HubSpot and Salesforce in under 10 minutes

## Who it is for
- VP of Sales and Head of RevOps at B2B software companies with 50 to 500 employees
